description: Source code for the HdmiInput plugin handling HDMI input devices, hotplug events, and EDID read/write operations within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: HdmiInput
classes.description: Main plugin class managing HDMI input devices, hotplug events, and EDID operations.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus and registers HDMI hotplug event handler.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Unregisters HDMI hotplug event handler and cleans up IARM bus.

methods.name: startHdmiInput
methods.description: Starts HDMI input on specified port.

methods.name: getHDMIInputDevices
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected HDMI input devices.

methods.name: writeEDID
methods.description: Stub for writing EDID data to a device.

methods.name: hdmiInputHotplug
methods.description: Handles hotplug events and notifies device change.

methods.name: dsHdmiEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for handling HDMI hotplug events from IARM bus.
